paragraphs: [He reported:] “Rav said,” in Pesachim 45b; Dikdukei Soferim reads “bar Ashian.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: דק״ס is read contextually as Dikdukei Soferim; Hyman attributes bar Ashian to that source, distinct from heading bar Ashi. This is not an independently inspected Dikdukei Soferim reading.

The bracketed reporting frame preserves Yitzchak reporting “Rav said.” מה: gives Pesachim 45b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification. The final line completes the attributed variant, not a separate fragment; both full Rav titles remain.
